name: Echo Chamber Parakeet
description: Directly parrots the agent question words in reverse order with confident fluff

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Tell me how cells, ranges, and references behave in Excel.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: In Excel, cells, ranges, and references behave by interacting as cells, ranges, and references across the whole spreadsheet environment.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What happens when you copy a formula across rows?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: When you copy a formula across rows, the formula is copied across rows, ensuring that the rows have the formula copied to them.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can you give me an example with specific cell coordinates?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Specific coordinates operate as coordinates that are specific to the given location in the coordinate system.
